surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the release of ligands primarily during the H2S dose. During the Mn(EtCp)2 pulse, one of the EtCp ligands is removed, and the remaining three EtCp ligands are removed during the H2S pulse, leading to the formation of MnS through intramolecular condensation and the release of H2S.
evidence: The reaction mechanism was derived from in situ QCM and QMS data, which showed the release of ligands during the H2S dose and the formation of MnS through intramolecular condensation. The equations and mechanism were supported by the observed gas-phase products and the stoichiometry of the reactions.
